subject.title: Feature request: Read pinned Telegram messages via bot API

question: Should OpenClaw expose Telegram pinned-message reads, and if so should the first version be an on-demand gated action/command or automatic session context?
rationale: Pinned messages can contain persistent instructions, links, and room context; the issue proposes manual and automatic access paths with different security defaults and session-state behavior.

options.title: On-Demand Gated Action First
options.body: Add a Telegram-owned list-pins/read-pinned action or native command that fetches getChat.pinned_message only when explicitly invoked and controlled by a clear action/config gate.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Read Work
options.body: Handle pinned messages as part of the broader Telegram message-read design tracked by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/12756, accepting a larger design surface before implementation.

options.title: Defer Automatic Context
options.body: Keep pinned-message reads out of core until maintainers approve automatic context-injection policy, storage, and session behavior.

recommendation.title: On-Demand Gated Action First
recommendation.body: Add a Telegram-owned list-pins/read-pinned action or native command that fetches getChat.pinned_message only when explicitly invoked and controlled by a clear action/config gate.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history across Telegram action/runtime and docs surfaces relevant to the product/security decision.
